name: The Eye Health Group of East Brunswick
status: excluded: chain/franchise - a Pearle Vision licensed-operator practice inside the EssilorLuxottica franchise network
what_they_do: Optometry group established 1 May 1991, now nine offices across NJ/NY, most of them inside or next to Pearle Vision stores; does comprehensive exams, ocular disease management and surgical co-management. The East Brunswick office at 326 NJ-18 North is one of those locations.
customers: Retail eyewear shoppers and local patients using vision insurance.

size_signals.signal: About page: established May 1 1991, grown to nine locations in the NJ/NY metro area
Optometrist openings for TEHG locations are posted on EssilorLuxottica's corporate careers site under a Pearle Vision store number

website_review.primary_cta: Book an appointment (links to scheduleyourexam.com third-party scheduler)
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Third-party scheduler link (scheduleyourexam.com) per location - not verified end-to-end
website_review.trust_signals: Years-in-business statement (since 1991), nine locations with named addresses/hours, insurance acceptance messaging
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Contacts page is a plain list with no map or photos; site has no schema.org markup at all; mismatched audit icon labels
website_review.search_basics: Home page title/description mention eye doctors but the contacts page title is just 'Contacts' with no town or service; no LocalBusiness structured data anywhere
top_issues: No schema.org LocalBusiness data on any page checked
Location pages are generic and not town-optimised
Brand and web platform decisions are set at Pearle Vision / EssilorLuxottica level

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: decent review volume (aggregator shows ~540 reviews at 4.7) and a crawlable site. Answerable: hours and addresses are plain text, but there is no JSON-LD and page titles do not name the town, so an agent has to scrape prose. Bookable: only a shared third-party scheduler link per location; no form, no quote path. Excluded from further work because the practice operates under the Pearle Vision franchise brand inside EssilorLuxottica, so local web/AI decisions are unlikely to sit with this office.

operations_signals.signal: Staffing is handled through parent-brand recruitment (optometrist requisitions on EssilorLuxottica careers site), suggesting centralised operations
One aggregator review notes online paperwork completed by a patient could not be found at check-in - inference: intake data is not flowing cleanly to the front desk

top_opportunities.opportunity: None pursued - franchise/chain outlet; brand, scheduling and web platform are controlled above the local office
top_opportunities.evidence: Careers page describes Pearle Vision Licensed Operator franchise structure under EssilorLuxottica; all locations share one template site

scores.reasons: Gap: real but modest (no schema, weak location pages). Pay: nine-location group with franchise backing, so money exists. Ease: very low - franchise brand guidelines and shared platforms mean a one-person consultancy cannot sell or implement changes here. Evidence: enough to classify, but I stopped short of a full site audit once the franchise relationship was confirmed.
